messages:
mira_pm: Quick sync: we need a concise rollout plan for 'Surge Sentinel' — objective: steer traffic gracefully during GPU contention using prioritized fallbacks and tenant weighting. Outline: flags, canary cadence, AB/shadow tests, region sequence, rollback ladder.
oliver_eng: +1. Suggest flag encodes ordered actions + tenant weight + region overrides. Keep canaries small and automated gating.
jade_sre: Safety proposal: tiny canary 0.25% x 20m, expanded canary 1% x 45m, then 5% x 90m. Auto-pause if 95p latency > 2.2s or error_rate > 0.75% in window. Add circuit breaker TTL 10m.
vanessa_data: Telemetry requirements: per-route p50/p95/p99, fallback_rate, tokens_saved, shadow_quality_diff. Shadow: 5% for 24h to build signal; store 1k hashed samples/day per-route. A/B: paired cohorts with human eval on top diffs.
ravi_ops: Runbook ladder: 1) regional kill-switch 2) set flag to last-stable variant 3) scale capacity if needed 4) notify customers. Need CLI parity for toggles and automated alerts to #incidents with top tenants.
legal_kim: Note for private deployments: do not route to hosted-only fallback variants. Add consent for telemetry; on-prem customers can opt-out and use local collector.
mira_pm: Decisions: 1) flag schema + minimal rollout API (oliver) 2) safety windows & canary cadence (jade) 3) telemetry contract (vanessa) 4) runbook + kill-switch (ravi) 5) private deploy rules + consent (legal_kim). Target: spec draft in 3 days, internal dry-run next week.
oliver_eng: Engineering caveat: context-trim fallback needs KV-cache versioning; switching mid-session must preserve continuity. Will add ticket.
jade_sre: region order suggestion: EU -> NA -> APAC with 2h cool-down between full-region ramps. Canary slices scoped per-region.
deploy-bot: deploybot: applied canary policy surge-sentinel on prod-canary at 1749007820; monitoring hooks enabled.
mira_pm: Thanks all. I'll draft the rollout playbook (flag json, acceptance criteria, telemetry fields, customer comms) and post link. Please add missing metrics here. :rocket:
